name: jyu_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite of a huge, heavy, burly paint monster shaped like a bear man, exactly the character in the front and side view references, with a face shaped like the front view reference. His whole body, face included, is made of glossy brown paint; the cream color lies in random, messy splotches and smears with ragged edges, wherever the paint happened to fall, as in the references. Very broad shoulders, thick arms, a big round belly, thick legs, small round ears, a short spiky tuft of hair on top, a round glossy black nose, the space between the nose and the mouth plain smooth paint, thick dark eyebrows, small half-lidded amber eyes with a stern look, the mouth slightly open with small fangs, paint dripping from the mouth, chin and hands, straight human-shaped legs with bare human feet and small paint puddles at the feet, arms hanging at his sides. Three-quarter view facing left, standing idle pose. Clean pixel art game sprite style: dark outline, glossy highlights, drips. Plain flat light gray background, the character alone.
